$comment: Authoritative attestation reference for the production publicai-gateway CVM (sub2api single-enclave architecture). Fetched at runtime by the /proof page (see frontend/src/utils/attestation/reference.ts). Every change to this file is public git history — that is part of the trust story. composeHash was read back from the CVM's RTMR3 via the attestor on 2026-07-28 and independently derives from deploy/phala/docker-compose.yml; image digests are the linux/amd64 children of the cosign-signed proof-v9 indexes built from sourceCommit by publish-tee-images (run 30337877905). The 2026-07-28 proof-v9 change adds cryptocurrency payment support as a Stripe sub-method (backend payment type 'crypto' routed through the existing Stripe channel and webhook, plus the frontend method ordering and admin toggle) — an application change, so both images were rebuilt and composeHash moved with them (f0097948… → c0136825…). The enclave's E2EE public key is derived from the app key and is unchanged across this upgrade.
